decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-24 MODIFY stating that the Hero V must be resolved before its geometry constructs the rest of the identity, which fully captures the prerequisite without further changes.
The É accent is already deferred by a message-24 Event until the Hero V is settled, so the source decision requires no additional value or scope change.
The second V development prerequisite does not alter the terminal-treatment requirement; its message-24 left-arm termination change is already represented independently.
The source decision governs when Hero V geometry may be extended to other letterforms and does not change the already-deferred champagne material treatment.
The remaining letterforms were already deferred until the V system is resolved, and message 24 does not change their construction or visual-language attributes.
Complete-wordmark work is already deferred, while the source decision does not modify the composition, kerning, or hierarchy requirements.
The development sequence for the second V does not change the standing brand-expression goals or ornamentation constraint.
The prerequisite for developing the second V does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
